about:
Aero-Med Industries Inc. operates from Cleveland, Ohio, where it has established itself as a machine shop serving aerospace and prototype needs. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names in its public materials.

The shop specializes in precision machining for both production and prototype runs, offering commercial machining services. Specific equipment, facility size, employee count, and annual volume are not published.

Aero-Med serves the aerospace sector and other commercial clients from its Cleveland location. The company does not name specific customers or programs in its public materials.

The company emphasizes a client-focused experience and credits its reputation to employee development and dedication, stating that its driving force is employees who have invested energy in the business and that it places primary importance on personal and professional growth.
